test_encode_integer_audio: test encoding integer audio data in s16, s32, s64 formats to WAV files using spdl.io Muxer
test_encode_float_audio: test encoding floating point audio data in f32, f64 formats to WAV files using spdl.io Muxer
test_encode_planar_audio: test encoding planar integer audio with 32 channels to NUT format using spdl.io Muxer
test_encode_audio_formats: test encoding audio to MP3, FLAC, and AAC formats using spdl.io Muxer with various sample formats
test_remux_audio: test remuxing audio from one container to another using spdl.io Demuxer and Muxer without re-encoding
